name: procureflow
description: ProcureFlow - Enterprise Procurement & Vendor Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
